E1302

`option` expects 3 arguments (name, help, metavar), got N

What

`option` expects 3 arguments (name, help, metavar), got N

Why

`ArgsSpec.option(name, help, metavar)` registers a value option like `--output FILE`; all three strings are required.

Fix

Pass three strings: the option name, a help description, and a placeholder like `FILE`, e.g. `.option("output", "write to FILE", "FILE")`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1302: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_option_arity.stderr.

Error [E1302]: `option` expects 3 arguments (name, help, metavar), got 2
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_option_arity.jet:5:25
    |
  5 |     spec :: args.spec().option("output", "write to FILE")
    |                         ^^^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.option(name, help, metavar)` registers a value option like `--output FILE`
 Fix: pass three strings: the option name, a help description, and a metavar like `FILE`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1302
